newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end higher across the board.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end higher across the board.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed higher in all months on Wednesday, as local investors continued to cover short positions, traders said.
Prices were 170 to 470 yen higher, and newly listed November ended at 15,160 yen per tonne.
Technical buying by individual investors supported the market, the traders said. The yen's weaker tone against the dollar also encouraged investors to buy, they said.
"Many investors holds many short positions particularly in the nearby month, and are waiting for good timing to cover them," a brokerage house trader said.
The spot December contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $2.86-1/4 per bushel at 0820 GMT, compared with $2.86-1/2 on Tuesday.
The spot November CBOT soybean futures contract was at $6.93 at 0820 GMT, up from $6.92-1/2 at Tuesday close.
